item.title: Standard Chartered names new Americas trade sales head
item.description: Standard Chartered has appointed João Galvão as head of trade sales, transaction banking, for the Americas. Galvão joins from Deutsche Bank, where he has spent the last 15 years, most recently as head of trade finance structuring, Americas. Based in New York, in his new position he will report to Bharat Padmanabhan, the bank’s global…
